headers.comment: Next writes content-hashed filenames here, so these can never go stale.
The hero video is the heaviest asset on the page and never changes in place.

HTML must revalidate or a deploy would not reach returning visitors for an hour (Firebase defaults HTML to max-age=3600). The bare '/' needs its own rule: header sources match the request path, and '**/*.html' never matches the root because cleanUrls serves index.html from '/'.
The service worker must never be served stale, or a bad worker outlives its fix. Browsers already bypass the HTTP cache for the SW script, but Firebase would otherwise default this to max-age=3600.
